---
title: "ARBITER results against blinded expert ratings"
---

```{r}
source('R/load.R')
source('R/presentation.R')
source('R/displays.R')
```

Two blinded human experts independently rated every trial domain without AI. The figures and tables below use the frozen independent ratings and the separate forced-choice endpoint.

## Results

```{r}
cat(readLines('output/manuscript/results-sentences.md',encoding='UTF-8'),sep='\n')
```

## Figures

```{r}
for(i in 1:6) cat('\n### Figure ',i,'\n\n![Figure ',i,'](output/manuscript/Figure',i,'.png)\n\n',sep='')
cat(readLines('output/manuscript/figure-legends.md',encoding='UTF-8'),sep='\n')
```

## Tables

```{r}
for(i in 1:4) {
  cat('\n### Table ',i,'\n\n',sep='')
  body <- system2('quarto',c('pandoc',paste0('output/manuscript/Table',i,'.docx'),'--to=html'),stdout=TRUE)
  stopifnot(is.null(attr(body,'status')))
  cat(body,sep='\n')
  cat('\n\n[Download Word table](output/manuscript/Table',i,'.docx)\n\n',sep='')
}
```

## Reproduction

The analysis pipeline, test suite and output verifier reproduce these results. The numerical CSVs and source traces accompany the figures. [Supplementary methods and results](supplement.html) provide all secondary estimates and reporting details. Trial PDFs are not redistributed.
